title: Doorbell Ding Dong
blurb: A classic two-tone ding-dong doorbell chime. This one triggers dogs, interrupts dinner, and makes streamers pause mid-sentence to check a door that doesn't exist. It's a staple prank sound for exactly that reason — play it on a call and watch someone actually get up. Also works as a clean scene-transition chime in edits. Original synthesis, free MP3 download.
origin: Original synthesis of the classic two-chime residential doorbell.
